title: Stable influences of a monomial
statement: Let $S$ be a finite set of coordinates, let $\varepsilon,\delta\in\mathbb{R}$, and suppose $0\leq\varepsilon$ and $(1-\delta)^{|S|-1}\leq\varepsilon$. Then every coordinate's stable influence, with parameter $1-\delta$, of the monomial on $S$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates
